newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam to sell 70 bln dong T-notes on Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam to sell 70 bln dong T-notes on Wednesday.

text.p: Vietnam will auction 70 billion dong ($5.9 million) worth of one-year Treasury notes on Wednesday, an official at the State Bank of Vietnam said on Tuesday.
At the last sale of government paper, on June 4, the central bank sold 70 billion dong worth of one-year Treasury notes to domestic institutions at an annual interest rate of 11.90 percent.
The government has held 11 Treasury paper auctions so far this year, through which a total of 449.4 billion dong worth of Treasury stock has been issued.(US$1=11,668 dong)
